regime.label: Dealer gamma split at the money: a long-gamma brake built above 1,050 over five sessions while the -4,271 short-gamma trough below 1,040 sits untouched
evidence: -4,271 is the summed net GEX below 1,050 against +3,945 at and above it, and the cumulative sum never crosses zero anywhere from 960 to 1,150 (-326.6 at the top), so there is no true gamma flip - but the per-strike net turns positive at the 1,050 strike (+346.8) and stays positive to the top of the strip. Spot 1,054.2 sits directly on that divide: dealers dampen above it, amplify below it.

+2,157.3 of the +2,278.8 five-session improvement in cumulative GEX (-2,605.4 on 2026-10-01 to -326.6 today) was added at and above 1,050; the trough below 1,050 moved only +121.5 (-4,392.8 to -4,271.3). Only the upside brake was built - the downside accelerator is intact.

+411 contracts of OI today (7,931 call / 8,352 put, 16,283 total) and +2,992 since 2026-10-01, a 22.5% five-session build. Expansion this fast rules out Unwind and fits a young 82-DTE back quarter still drawing its risk map; call OI added +292 against put +119, the first call-led session since 2026-10-03.

225 lots traded the 1,040 put but its OI fell -68, and the 1,030 put shed -53 on 111 lots, at 9.78% and 10.20% IV - the two cheapest OTM put vols on the board. Vol2Vol fails at the near-money put shelf: volume with no OI build and flat IV means that downside bid is being closed, not renewed. The only building put is the 1,692-OI 960 floor (+38), 94.2 points or 12.4 daily sigma away, which is structural rather than live.

S50Z26.today_summary: 1,054.2 on the Dec future is +1.7 today and 4.2 points above max pain 1,050 - a fourth consecutive up session, but each step is smaller (+5.1, +2.5, +2.8, +1.7) and the pain bowl is shallow: 674,450 at 1,050 against 680,720 at 1,060 and 682,490 at 1,040, a 1.2% dish across 20 points. Net dealer GEX splits hard at the money, -4,271 summed below 1,050 against +3,945 at and above it, so the cumulative sum still never flips positive anywhere in the 960-1,150 strip (-326.6 at the top) while spot sits exactly on the divide. Put/call volume cooled 1.55 to 1.13 as call lots rose 853 to 1,077 (+26%) and put lots fell 1,322 to 1,218; the OI ratio slipped to 1.0531, its lowest since 2026-09-22. 11.39% ATM IV is -0.06 on the day and sits in the bottom third of the 17-session 10.57-13.70% range, pricing a 7.57-point daily move and leaving the 1,100 call wall 45.8 points - 6.05 daily sigma - away.
what_changed: Cumulative net GEX climbed -770.5 to -326.6 (+443.9), an eighth straight negative session but the shallowest reading since 2026-09-30; +243.1 of that came from the shelf at and above 1,050 and +200.8 from below it.
Put/call volume ratio fell 1.55 to 1.13 - call lots +26% (853 to 1,077) against put lots 1,322 to 1,218 - and the OI ratio slipped 1.0778 to 1.0531, the lowest since 2026-09-22.

Near-money put OI closed out (1,040 -68 on 225 lots, 1,030 -53 on 111 lots) while the money built two-way: 1,050 call +87 on 139 lots, 1,050 put +74 on 181 lots, and 1,060 call +56 on the board's heaviest call volume at 219 lots.
25-delta call band stepped 1,080 to 1,090 (+10) while ATM IV ticked 11.45% to 11.39% (-0.06): the implied distribution shifted up without anyone paying more for vol.
S50Z26.five_day_thesis: +12.3 points in five sessions (1,041.9 on 2026-10-01 to 1,054.2) has recovered 45% of the -27.1 gap that opened the window, and max pain has drifted 1,060 to 1,050, now 4.2 points under spot. The decisive change is where the gamma went: cumulative net GEX improved +2,278.8 (-2,605.4 to -326.6), but +2,157.3 of that was added at and above 1,050 while the trough below 1,050 moved just +121.5 (-4,392.8 to -4,271.3) - a one-sided brake, not a repaired structure. No cumulative gamma flip has existed anywhere in the strip for eight sessions (the last was 1,140 on 2026-09-29), so there is no stabilising shelf beneath the money if 1,040 gives way. Meanwhile the 960 put wall has built eight sessions straight, 1,208 to 1,692 OI (+40%), while 1,030/1,040 put OI is now being closed: protection is migrating out of the money and into the tail. ATM IV went 11.48% to 11.39% across a +12.3-point rally and 25-delta skew normalised -3.16 to -1.29, so nobody paid up for the move - the cheap-vol window is still open, which favours owning the asymmetry over selling it.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1040 / 970
strategies.rationale: 9.78% IV on the 1,040 put is the cheapest OTM put vol on the board and the 970 put at 14.29% is 4.51 points richer, so the +1.84 ten-delta barbell finances the hedge; it owns the -4,271 short-gamma shelf below 1,050, where dealer re-hedging sells into weakness instead of fading it, down to the 1,692-OI floor at 960.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = net debit of about 12.7 points (1,040 put 17.3 ask less 970 put 4.6 bid); the 70-point width caps max gain near 57.3 points, breakeven 1,027.3.
strategies.invalidation: A sustained close above 1,080 (+629.9 net GEX, 3.4 daily sigma up) - spot that deep inside the long-gamma shelf leaves the 1,040 strike 40 points below and the spread becomes pure decay.

strategies.name: Call credit spread 1090 / 1110
strategies.rationale: 12.77% IV on the 1,090 call is the richest on the call strip and 1,090 is today's 25-delta band (stepped up from 1,080), sitting inside the long-gamma shelf (+504.4 at 1,090, +1,075.5 at the 1,100 wall) where dealers sell rallies - but 3.4 credit against 16.6 max loss is a 20% return on risk with ATM IV in the bottom third of its 17-session range, so short vol is paid little here and the negative-skew payoff argues for small size.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 20-point width less 3.4 net credit = 16.6 points (1,090 call 8.4 bid, 1,110 call 5.0 ask); breakeven 1,093.4, which is +39.2 points or 5.18 daily sigma away.
strategies.invalidation: A close above 1,093.4, or the 1,100 call wall (1,289 OI) shrinking across sessions - the long-gamma brake unwinding removes the dampening this structure leans on.

S50Z26.prediction: 1,050-1,060 is the base case: spot 1,054.2 sits on the gamma divide with +346.8 net GEX at 1,050 and +118.8 at 1,060 damping the grind, the 1,100 wall 6.05 daily sigma away, and a 1.2% pain bowl offering only a weak pull back to 1,050. The asymmetry is the real read - a close below 1,040 drops price into the -4,271 short-gamma shelf where dealer hedging sells into weakness, and the 1,000-1,020 strikes deteriorated a further -236.8 net GEX over five sessions, so downside would travel faster than the 7.57-point daily sigma implies. A sustained close above 1,080 (+629.9 net GEX) invalidates that asymmetry and turns the structure into a pure long-gamma grind toward the 1,100 wall.
S50Z26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice, and no position size is implied. SET50 options are cash-settled on the SET50 index with no physical delivery, so the dealer-hedging mechanics behind pinning and max-pain magnetism are structurally weaker here than for share-settled single stocks: treat the 1,050 anchor as a tendency, not a guarantee, and at 82 DTE the pin mechanism (ATM gamma rising as time to expiry falls) is barely active at all. The 1.2% pain bowl across 1,040-1,060 and the absence of any cumulative gamma flip in the 960-1,150 strip both argue for low confidence in mean reversion; macro or news flow can override the option structure outright, and a 1,040 break with expanding volume and IV would be the max-pain failure pattern, not something to fade. Defined-risk structures cap the loss but that capped loss is real - short-vol payoffs are negative-skew, small frequent gains against rare large losses.
